title: Pose Games
shortDescription: A playful, movement-driven challenge where participants recreate on-screen poses and shapes. It sparks laughter, creativity, and instant physical engagement.
longDescription: This game invites people to step in front of a screen and mimic dynamic poses, gestures, or silhouettes shown in real time. Using body movement as the only controller, it turns spectators into active participants and creates spontaneous, shareable moments without any app or hardware to hand out. Rounds run solo or head to head, scale from a quick icebreaker to a timed competition, and shift in difficulty as players warm up. Pose sets, scoring, theming, and branding are all configurable, so the same setup brings energy, motion, and shared joy to an entertainment zone, a team session, or a family installation. BRDGE handles it end to end: body tracking and match detection, scene management, and the links to journey, leaderboard, and data outputs.

highlights.title: Instant, no-instructions
highlights.description: No app and no learning curve. People just step up and move, which makes it an easy crowd-pleaser to pitch for almost any audience or event type.

highlights.title: Sponsor Editions & Tournaments
highlights.description: Swap in a sponsor edition with branded rewards and visuals, turn it into a tournament or leaderboard mode across teams and time slots, or carry outcomes into a personal recap and post-event reward flow.

highlights.title: Festive, Museum or Brand Worlds
highlights.description: Reskin the same interaction as a winter or festive edition, a museum or education storyline that reveals facts as people play, or a branded campaign world that feels native to the client.

highlights.title: Engagement You Can Measure
highlights.description: Bolt on a data layer to track starts, active users, completion and repeat plays, plus behaviour signals like timing and accuracy, and connect it to tokens, galleries, or dashboards for post-event reporting that evidences engagement.

highlights.title: Pairs With many Other Modules
highlights.description: Pair it with Visitor Identificator for identity and personalised follow-up, with a Memory Catcher to capture a player's poses as a photo, GIF, or video takeaway, with a shared gallery to recap the best moments, or with a Leaderboard for live head-to-head competition.

states.trigger: No one detected in the camera zone.
states.experience: A looping invitation plays and demo silhouettes cycle to show people exactly what to do.
states.feedback: Ambient motion, looping prompt, a clear step-in cue.
states.configurable: Attract visuals, branding, demo pose set, audio bed.
states.data: Footfall near the zone, attract-to-play conversion.

states.trigger: A body enters the tracked zone.
states.experience: The system locks on, runs a short calibration, and explains the goal before the round starts.
states.feedback: Skeleton or outline highlight, countdown, short prompt.
states.configurable: Countdown length, instruction copy, number of players.

states.experience: Target poses appear and players move to match them inside the time limit, with difficulty able to ramp across rounds.
states.feedback: Live match meter, score ticks, hit and miss cues, energetic music.
states.configurable: Pose set, round count, time per pose, match tolerance, difficulty curve.
states.data: Poses attempted, match accuracy, reaction time, per-round score.

states.experience: Score reveal, an optional snapshot of the best pose, and an optional ranking against other players.
states.feedback: Win animation, score card, optional captured photo.
states.configurable: Scoring rules, reward or voucher logic, snapshot capture, leaderboard push.
states.data: Final scores, completion rate, photos captured, share or opt-in actions.

states.trigger: The player leaves or the session times out.
states.experience: The session clears and the screen returns to the attract loop.
states.feedback: Brief thank-you, then a fade back to attract.
states.configurable: Timeout duration, end-screen call to action.
